ruling_text:
Plaintiff filed a motion to vacate dismissal and enter judgment pursuant to stipulation.
The Motion and its supporting documents are timely.
This Motion is unopposed. However, this motion was originally scheduled for 2/24/06,
but was rescheduled for 3/24/26. And though there was mail notice for the 2/24/26
appearance, it does not appear that the court notified Defendant of the new date.
This was the court’s mistake and it extends its apology.
Disposition
Motion will be continued to 6/2/26, 9am.
Plaintiff to notify Defendant.
